note: pdfcn.dev (www.pdfcn.dev) — React-PDF component registry with two namespaces, takumi/ and forme/. A registry name is '<namespace>/<name>' and surfaces as id '<namespace>-<name>', which is exactly what a page /docs/components/<namespace>/<name> (48) or /docs/blocks/<namespace>/<name> (20) produces, so 68 of 79 items take that page's url. The 11 left without a url are the two utils items and the 9 theme-* items, whose only pages are /docs/themes/<name> — the slug lacks the theme- prefix the registry uses, so it cannot attach. robots: no rules.
